notes: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles, cross-checked by PlanetGTA6). Every guide below is written for this entry in its own words; a trophy whose method no source has confirmed says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no extra task behind it: finish the story, the 100% completion checklist and the side work, and this is the last one to land.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story and work down the in-game checklist: the story, 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, the fencing totals, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 of 125 flamingos, 30 of 40 races won, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges and 15 of 15 of Bret's target decks. You only need the listed portion of each activity, not everything in the game — the checklist shows the exact numbers, so stop each activity the moment its line is done.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count and can be mixed, so use whatever is nearest. The game holds 397 stunts in total and 100% completion asks for 300, so keep jumping after this trophy pops if you are chasing the gold.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — one session of each is enough, you do not need to win or finish any of them. The types are the ones the 100% checklist names: arcade games, bowling, pool, mini golf, basketball, fishing, the shooting range, drone racing and races.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and protect the first one. After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation. PowerPyx and GTABase flag this as the only possibly missable trophy, because that first balcony meditation can only be done early in Chapter 1. Do it before leaving Chapter 1 and keep a manual save from before it. The other 17 spots can be found any time afterwards, and 100% completion only needs 15 of 18.

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand hands you target animals to track down — take the unique one he marks. His full Target Deck (15 objectives) is also on the 100% checklist, so keep hunting after this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set counts when every card in it is found. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting after the third.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app and scan 100 locations. Scan vehicles and landmarks as you travel — start early and it finishes itself over the course of the game; the app marks what you have already scanned so you never double-count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's Challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more, and the in-game list tracks each one — pick the easy ones first. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so keep going after this trophy.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose the police and escape. Grab a fast car, break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear — the trophy pops once the wanted level is gone with your partner still with you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Keep the heat on through all three robberies — do not let the stars clear between shops — then escape after the third.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The WAiNK app logs new vehicles as you scan or drive them — scan everything you pass and the count climbs on its own. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so keep scanning after this trophy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down five enemies before it ends. Pick a busy fight, wait until five enemies are in view, then trigger it and chain the kills.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport — get aboard as one is leaving and take off with it. This is the method the guides report, but they also say the exact trigger is still being confirmed, so treat the details as unconfirmed until a guide pins them down.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Tanks appear at military sites — take one, then fire its cannon in a fight.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, stay out of the cameras' and guards' sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. The big vault jobs open through the optional mission “That's Where The Money Is…” in Chapter 4. There are eight vaults in total and the 100% checklist needs all eight, so do not stop at five.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Gang operations are marked on the map — hit one per gang and the trophy is yours. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations done, so this is only the start of that work.

trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train strength for both characters — gym work and melee brawls build it — until each one is maxed out.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Almost everything criminal counts — robberies, thefts, getaways — so it builds up naturally across a full playthrough; check the profile screen to see the count.

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garage properties. Garages appear for sale around Leonida — buy each one when you can afford it, and the trophy lands with the last deed.
